definition: Oracle Reports is a toolset for designing and publishing formatted reports from database data.
example: A developer creates a report template that renders a monthly transaction summary.

definition: Oracle Workflow provides facilities for defining, routing and tracking business processes and notifications.
example: A purchase request is routed to the approvers defined in its workflow.

definition: Oral cancer screening looks for signs that warrant further evaluation through visual or tactile examination of the mouth and surrounding areas.
example: A dental clinician refers a patient for evaluation of an unexplained oral lesion.

definition: Organizational culture change works to shift shared norms and everyday behaviors through consistent leadership, incentives and practices.
example: A department reinforces a new safety culture by rewarding reports of near misses.

definition: Organizational leadership guides people and decisions toward shared goals while managing resources, alignment and accountability.
example: A leader clarifies priorities when two teams compete for the same resources.

definition: OrientDB is a database engine that supports document and graph data models.
example: A developer stores customer records and traverses relationships between related accounts.

definition: Orthopaedic nursing provides care for people with musculoskeletal injuries, conditions or procedures.
example: A nurse monitors comfort and mobility goals after a patient's joint surgery.

definition: OpenTelemetry is a set of open specifications and libraries for generating, collecting and exporting telemetry such as traces, metrics and logs.
example: An engineer instruments a service to export request traces to an observability backend.
sense_note: OpenTelemetry is instrumentation and transport infrastructure, not itself an analytics backend.

definition: OutSystems is a low-code platform for building, deploying and maintaining enterprise applications.
example: A developer uses visual tools to assemble an approval app and connect it to business data.

definition: Over-the-road driving operates commercial vehicles over extended routes while managing schedules, cargo, vehicle condition and driving requirements.
example: A driver plans stops for a multistate delivery and completes the required vehicle checks.

definition: Overhead cost analysis identifies and evaluates indirect costs and how they are allocated across activities, products or departments.
example: An accountant compares production support costs when revising allocation rates.

definition: Overhead crane operation uses a bridge, gantry or similar overhead crane to lift and move loads within operating limits.
example: A trained operator follows an approved lift plan to place a component at a workstation.

definition: A package.json file is a JSON manifest that describes a JavaScript project or package and may declare dependencies, scripts and entry points.
example: A maintainer adds a test script and declares project dependencies in its manifest.
sense_note: It is a configuration format, not an executable tool.

definition: Packaging machine operation sets up and monitors equipment that fills, wraps, seals or labels goods for distribution.
example: An operator checks that package seals and labels meet specifications during a run.

definition: Padrino is a Ruby web application framework built on Sinatra that adds project organization and application components.
example: A developer adds admin routes and templates to a small web application.

definition: Page layout arranges text, images and white space on a printed or digital page to support readability and intent.
example: A designer positions headlines and columns to create a clear reading order.

definition: Pallet building arranges and secures goods on a pallet for stable storage, handling or shipment.
example: A warehouse worker stacks cartons within load limits and secures them before dispatch.

definition: Palm OS was an operating system for handheld devices such as Palm organizers and some early smartphones.
example: A user synchronized appointments between a Palm OS organizer and a desktop computer.

definition: Pandas is a Python library for manipulating labeled tabular and time-series data.
example: An analyst joins two tables by customer identifier and calculates totals by month.

definition: The Paperwork Reduction Act is a U.S. federal law governing many agency information collections and their burden on the public.
example: An agency estimates respondent burden when preparing an information collection for review.

definition: Parallel computing executes multiple parts of a computation at the same time using multiple processing resources.
example: A scientific program distributes independent simulations across available processors.

definition: PARI/GP is a computational mathematics system focused on number theory, with a C library and an interactive GP interface.
example: A mathematician factors an integer and experiments with number-theoretic functions in GP.

definition: Parrot AR.Drone was a small remotely operated quadcopter with onboard cameras and networked controls.
example: A robotics student used its camera to observe a marked indoor test course.

definition: Passport.js is authentication middleware for Node.js applications that supports different login mechanisms through strategies.
example: A web service uses a strategy to handle sign-in through an approved identity provider.

definition: Pathlore refers to learning management software used to administer training, enrollment and progress records.
example: A training administrator assigns employees to a course and checks completion.
sense_note: Legacy product label; confirm the exact edition before claiming features beyond learning management.

definition: Patient coordination organizes appointments, referrals, communications and care transitions among patients and providers.
example: A coordinator ensures a specialist has the referral documents and confirms the appointment with the patient.

definition: Patient education helps people understand health information and participate in decisions or self-care appropriate to their needs.
example: A clinician uses teach-back to check whether a patient understands follow-up instructions.

definition: Patient transfer moves a patient safely between positions, surfaces or care locations while managing mobility and continuity of care.
example: A care team uses the appropriate equipment to move a patient from a bed to a chair.
sense_note: May refer to physical movement or transfer of care between facilities; document the intended sense.

definition: Pattern Lab is a tool for developing and previewing reusable interface patterns and their composition into pages.
example: A front-end team checks how a card component works in multiple layouts.

definition: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard defines security requirements for protecting payment card data in applicable environments.
example: A merchant documents controls around the systems that handle cardholder data.

definition: PDF conversion changes a file to PDF or transforms a PDF into another format while managing formatting and data fidelity.
example: A user converts a text-based PDF to an editable document and checks table alignment.

definition: PDF generation creates a PDF document from source content, templates or application data.
example: A billing service renders a PDF invoice from order and payment records.

definition: PDF.js is a JavaScript library for parsing and rendering PDF documents in a web environment.
example: A browser application uses PDF.js to display document pages without a separate viewer plug-in.

definition: A PDF viewer renders PDF content for reading, navigation and related tasks such as searching or annotation where supported.
example: A reviewer searches a PDF manual for a part number.

definition: PDFlib is a programming library for generating and processing PDF documents.
example: An application uses PDFlib to create reports that embed fonts and charts.

definition: PDFNet is a software development kit for adding PDF viewing, editing, conversion or processing capabilities to applications.
example: A document application uses the SDK to add comments to PDF pages.

definition: PDFtk is a tool for manipulating PDF files, including combining, splitting and rotating pages.
example: A user assembles several separate scans into a single multi-page PDF.

definition: Peachtree Accounting was desktop accounting software for small-business bookkeeping, invoicing and financial reporting.
example: A bookkeeper recorded customer invoices and produced a balance sheet.
sense_note: Legacy brand; do not infer capabilities of current Sage products.

definition: Pelvic floor rehabilitation assesses and treats pelvic floor muscle dysfunction to improve symptoms and function.
example: A qualified clinician develops an individualized plan based on an assessment of movement and symptoms.

definition: Percona XtraDB was an enhanced InnoDB-compatible storage engine developed for MySQL-family database servers.
example: A database administrator evaluated XtraDB when tuning a legacy transactional workload.
sense_note: Do not confuse the storage engine with the Percona XtraDB Cluster product.
